This window is ordinary/MTP R1 with default overlap off and MTP K1. It measures the current image; it is not evidence for R2 continuation performance.
Natural IDs, accepted drafts and target/draft work may differ across arms; these are complete natural-consumer observations, not equal-mathematical-work or task-quality rankings.
Rates are medians of3 and retain their min/max plus original samples in the archive; no statistical-significance or individual-optimization causal claim.

Memory uses1 independent process per arm/workload, excluded from timing medians. PSAPI/PDH peaks are sampled lower bounds; do not sum independent dedicated/shared maxima or RAM/commit as physical totals.
